idea-plugin.name: Photo Placeholders
idea-plugin.description:
Insert real placeholder photos into HTML, CSS, Markdown, JSX or any file, powered by the free picsum.photos service.

Features

  • Any size or square images: random, a specific image id, or a stable seed.
  • Grayscale and blur (1–10) filters, .jpg / .webp extensions.
  • Automatic ?random=N so every inserted image is different, even with multiple carets.
  • Output as URL, HTML <img>, CSS background, Markdown, JSX or a src attribute.
  • Live preview and a browsable gallery to pick a specific photo and see its author.
  • Remembers your last settings; one-click insert with them.
  • Live templates: picsum, picsumimg, picsumbg, picsummd.

Usage

Code | Generate… (Alt+Insert / ⌘N) → Placeholder Photo…, or right-click in the editor. Assign your own shortcut under Settings | Keymap.

Privacy

The plugin collects no data. It only downloads images and image metadata from picsum.photos when you open the generator or insert an image.

Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with picsum.photos. Photos come from Unsplash via picsum.photos. Source code: github.com/jamesmosq/photo-placeholders.
